objective: Determine whether the pinned source itself supplies an explicit coarse/refined amplitude or boundary-state map that could support a genuine refinement bridge for the already validated DVD2/DVD3 amplitudes.

classification_rule.EXPLICIT_REFINEMENT_MAP_CANDIDATE_FOUND: At least one source passage contains an explicit mathematical map/operator/relation connecting two discretization levels or boundary/amplitude spaces, not merely a comparison of different diagrams, an auxiliary cutoff, or a sum over labels.
classification_rule.SOURCE_REFINEMENT_AUTHORITY_NOT_FOUND: No such explicit map is present after all frozen query classes and surrounding source contexts are audited.
classification_rule.SOURCE_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE: Candidates exist but cannot be classified unambiguously from source text/context alone.
classification_rule.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL: Pinned source cannot be fetched/verified/extracted or audit code fails before classification.

claim_locks: A positive candidate does not itself derive a bridge; it only authorizes implementing the exact source map in a later frozen numerical gate.
A negative result applies only to this pinned source and does not show that Lorentzian EPRL lacks refinement maps in the literature.
Finite shell cutoff D is not to be re-labelled as refinement.
